content:
Q3 (frontend lexicon validation bundle) resolved: include.

Frontend bundles proto-blue-lexicon and a minimal Registry containing the schemas operators can author records against in the UI (v1: com.atproto.label.defs, app.bsky.labeler.service). User-constructed records validate client-side via Registry::validate() before submission; errors inline, no network round-trip.

Doc changes:
- REQ-13 added: frontend includes proto-blue-lexicon + minimal registry.
- AC-16 added: invalid composer input surfaces error within 100ms, zero HTTP requests for validation; wasm-objdump confirms lexicon engine in bundle.
- §D Frontend section: paragraph added about the lexicon bundle being an accepted trade-off, with note that the registry is shaped to allow further trimming if needed.
- Q3 marked RESOLVED inline; captured by REQ-13/AC-16.
